c-admin-blocks-shortcodes-widgets.16.evidence: Site seeded to 2,054 published topics (seed-scale + 700 copied rows), 79 distinct authors; Forum feed block (jetonomy/forum-feed count=50) as member bob on /walk-recent-50/. Times hold: browser load 136 ms first, 72 ms second, curl TTFB ~38 ms, PHP render 10 ms; 50 topic rows shown. Query shape does NOT hold on the stock install (no persistent object cache, wp_using_ext_object_cache() false): each page request, cold or warm, runs 56 queries = 1 batched post query, batched users/usermeta/profiles/blocked-users, and 50 separate single-row wp_options reads of _transient_jt_grav_chk_<author id> (one per distinct author), repeated identically on 3 consecutive fresh requests. Inside one PHP request the second render is 1 query, because the transient reads are then cached in memory. So 'warm render = one batched query pass, no per-row queries' fails across requests: a per-author lookup that could be primed with one wp_options IN() read. The [jetonomy_recent_posts count=50] shortcode renders 1 query warm. Product perf finding or an over-strict line: main session decides.
